_note: 2026-10-27: two Baidu photos — ANA jets on the apron and a Shuri Castle mural in the terminal — join the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

oka-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，那霸机场（OKA）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
oka-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Naha International Airport (OKA) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

oka-baidu-1.webp.zh: 那霸机场机坪上排开的全日空客机：尾翼前后重叠，远处是海面与跨海道路。
oka-baidu-1.webp.en: ANA jets lined up on the apron at Naha — tail fins overlapping, with the sea and a causeway beyond.

oka-baidu-2.webp.zh: 那霸机场航站楼内的壁画：身着冲绳传统服饰的人物与首里城图案，上方写着「首里城复兴应援」。
oka-baidu-2.webp.en: A mural inside Naha's terminal — figures in Okinawan dress before Shuri Castle, headed by a banner supporting the castle's restoration.
